pre_mortem: It is Monday and both unders lost. Jefferson went over because the backup locked onto him for 8-plus targets into the middle PIT has allowed at 10.09 YPA, Highsmith never rushed, and Porter either sat or got beaten on one intermediate crosser, so the McCarthy blitz split was the wrong quarterback's stat. Austin went over on one 40-to-70-yard shot in a second-half PIT chase, the same spike already in his log (70, 22, 34), and Minnesota's 5-of-92 explosive rate was just the first three opponents. The missing prices were the other miss: both unders were already shaded after a public injury report and a closing MIN -2.5, so even a right read was a bad number. Warren also played a full receiving game and was correctly left off.
slip_story: One story only: 41.5 outdoor slog, MIN pass game degraded without McCarthy, PIT unable to live on explosives against the MIN lid. The two unders win together in that script and are not mixed with Mason overs, team-total overs, or TD legs. They are not the same failure mode: a functional MIN backup kills Jefferson and can leave Austin under; a PIT comeback bomb kills Austin and can leave Jefferson under. A true shootout kills both. No third leg. Questionable Warren, Smith, and Porter stay off until inactives. This is a candidate slip, not a bet.
